title: Guidelines for starters for squirrel-cage motors
headers: Ratio of starting torque to locked rotor torques %
markdown:
| Type of Starter | Percentage of Voltage Reduction | Maximum Starting Current | Ratio of starting torque to locked rotor torques % |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DOL | Nil | 6 × FLC | 100 |
| Star-delta | 58% | 2 × FLC | 33 |
| Auto-Transformer | tap 50% | 1.68 × FLC | 25 |
|  | tap 65% | 2.7 × FLC | 42 |
|  | tap 80% | 4 × FLC | 64 |
| Soft Start | 40% to 65% | 3 × FLC |  |
| Variable Frequency Drive | 40% to 90% | 2.5 × FLC to 5 × FLC | 20 to 80 |
notes: Note: As per torque speed characteristics of the motor, the torque of the motor at the chosen percentage of reduced voltage shall be adequate to accelerate the pump to the full speed. The starting torque of a pump is usually low at about 20% to 25% of the full load torque. Therefore, even a voltage reduction of 60% to 65% during starting can accelerate the pump.
Soft Start prints no torque ratio; the cell is retained as empty rather than filled from a neighbouring row.
Auto-Transformer is printed only on the tap 50% row; the following two Type cells have visible horizontal borders and are retained blank, without a vertical merge.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi full-page PNGs and 288-300 dpi region crops, with sideways pages rotated upright before reading; no OCR, no native-text values, no paid service
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every cell, power, dash, blank and footnote was read from the image and retained as printed; printed anomalies are listed in notes and were not corrected.

visual_recheck.method: Distinct parent visual comparison against source-region PNGs and rotated or zoomed crops; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Compared every table cell and formula term; checked footnotes, blank cells, numerical outliers and skipped row numbering. Removed inferred rowspan across separately bordered Type cells.
